units.rawText:
"Dear player: You will be playing a veteran captain who has sailed the mysterious and treacherous oceans many times in the past. Although you've contended with the waves many times, you have had nothing to show for it.
You want to challenge the sea one last time while you still have breath in you and win a treasure to prove your worth, allowing your legend to be passed down from mariner to mariner throughout the ages.
Your mission: to guide everyone across this treacherous sea voyage and bring everyone home successfully. You fail if any of your crew die."
